@graph.name: Warehouse Racking & Distribution-Center Decommissioning Dataset — I-81 Corridor
@graph.description: The dedicated dataset of the Warehouse Racking + Distribution-Center Decommissioning program of The Flat Rate Movers: one engagement — pallet-rack teardown and removal, used-rack buyback with the credit shown as a line item against the fixed flat-rate total, anchor removal and slab patch for a landlord-ready handback, transport between buildings, reinstallation and re-anchoring, inventory and product relay — at one flat rate in writing, across the six distribution markets of the I-81 corridor: Hagerstown and Washington County MD, Winchester and Frederick County VA, Martinsburg and Berkeley County WV, Front Royal and Warren County VA, Harrisonburg and Rockingham County VA, and Staunton and Augusta County VA. The dataset carries the six market Places with their named industrial stock and sources, the eleven service doors of the category (decommissioning, rack teardown, racking relocation, reinstallation and re-anchoring, buyback, lease handback, inventory relay, transport, cost, process, and best-choice), the per-area Service nodes bound to the dedicated pages that own each market, and the coverage matrix of areas by doors. Pricing is per job: one flat rate agreed in writing before work starts; no per-bay or per-beam rate and no resale benchmark is published in this dataset.

@graph.serviceType: Warehouse racking relocation and distribution-center decommissioning
@graph.description: Warehouse racking + distribution-center decommissioning, priced as one flat rate in writing: as-built rack inventory and condition survey; phased pallet-rack dismantling bay by bay; anchor removal and slab patch for a landlord-ready handback; banding, palletizing and load-out; used-rack buyback with the credit shown as a line item against the fixed flat-rate total; transport between buildings; reinstallation and re-anchoring at the destination; inventory and product relay, pack-out and re-slotting support; storage in leased space between buildings; phased work in live buildings, nights and weekends included.
